100: A girl cuts her hair, takes her dad's armour and joins the army in his place; a tiny red dragon tags along.
A girl with 70 feet of magic hair is kept in a tower by a woman pretending to be her mum.
A boy raised by wolves is chased by a tiger and gets life advice from a lazy bear.
A mammoth, a sloth and a sabre-tooth tiger return a lost human baby; a squirrel just wants his acorn.
A sponge who lives in a pineapple flips burgers for a greedy crab who guards a secret recipe.
A doll in a perfect pink world starts thinking about death, gets flat feet and drives to Los Angeles.
200: A drunk pirate wants his ship back from a crew who turn into skeletons in the moonlight.
A bride secretly invites three men to her wedding on a Greek island, because one of them is her dad.
A New York cop with no shoes fights terrorists in a Los Angeles office tower during a Christmas party.
A robot from the future travels back to 1984 to kill a waitress before her son is born.
A pilot who refuses to be promoted trains young pilots for an impossible mission, including his dead best friend's son.
A rude genius in a long coat solves crimes in London; his flatmate is an army doctor who blogs about it.
300: A teenager poses as a pilot, a doctor and a lawyer while the FBI agent chasing him gets a phone call from him every Christmas.
A jazz pianist and an actress in Los Angeles both get their dream careers and lose each other along the way.
A physicist builds the world's most dangerous bomb, then sits through a long hearing about his security clearance.
A boy from the slums of Mumbai knows every answer on a quiz show, so the police assume he's cheating.
Two US marshals search an island hospital for a missing patient; one of them may be a patient himself.
A ballerina wants the lead role so badly that she starts growing feathers.
400: A blood-spatter expert for the Miami police spends his nights killing killers, following rules his adoptive dad taught him.
A man lives in a New York airport for months because his country fell apart while he was in the air.
A Soviet chemist spends five episodes trying to convince officials that the reactor core really has exploded.
A baseball manager with no money hires a Yale economics graduate to pick his players with a spreadsheet.
A hiker's arm gets stuck under a boulder in a canyon, and he has to make a hard decision with a cheap knife.
A boy in the Hitler Youth has Hitler as his imaginary friend, while his mum hides a Jewish girl in the walls.
500: A creepy man in Los Angeles films car crashes at night and sells the footage to the morning news.
An actor famous for playing a winged superhero tries a Broadway comeback, and the whole film looks like one long shot.
A shy Paris waitress secretly fixes strangers' lives, starting by returning a tin box of a man's childhood toys.
A linguist learns to read the aliens' circle writing and starts seeing her future daughter.
A five-year-old who has spent his whole life in a garden shed with his mum thinks it's the whole world.
No baby has been born for 18 years, and a tired man has to get the only pregnant woman to the coast.
